Other lanes' failing tests, not ours: `tests\test_request_windows.R` (FEC pagination fixture) and one HTTP test in `tests\test_report_insights.py`. Cap floor (>= 100) lives on the env var in the exporter; the function itself accepts any positive cap so tests can fold at 6.

s10.old: - **LESSON (git):** `git apply --cached --unidiff-zero` SILENTLY MISPLACES pure-insertion hunks when earlier hunks were dropped (cumulative +N offset drift) and `--check` passes anyway (no context to validate) - it corrupted the builder index (functions landed inside buildAuditTable / a Map literal = invalid JS). Fix that WORKED: reconstruct HEAD+A by `git apply`-ing A's default-context hunks onto the pristine `git show HEAD:file` blob (core.autocrlf=false so scratch stays LF), delete the lone foreign line, let `git diff` author a clean default-context A-only patch, `apply --cached` that; PROVE with `node --check` on the staged blob (`git show :file`). STILL UNCOMMITTED after `b44fcef7a`: every other lane's foreign hunks + all .bak-* + node_modules.
s10.why: "earlier hunks" are hunks earlier in a patch file, not text in the note

s10.old: - **TRAP that cost an incomplete commit (`991b06568`):** the Mentat repo's root `.gitignore` has `*.html` AND `*.txt` AND `*.json` (`index.html` is tracked only because it was force-added). `git add` silently skipped nine new `.html` partials, and git's stderr had been sent to /dev/null, so the "paths are ignored" warning never showed; the identity check passed because it ran in the WORKING TREE where the files existed. Rules: never redirect git's stderr on add/commit; after every commit read its own "create mode" list against the file list you meant; prove HEAD from `git -c core.autocrlf=false archive HEAD ... | tar -x` in a fresh scratch folder, with the previous commit as a negative control; run `git check-ignore -v` on every NEW file first. Fix: added `!mentat/app/templates/*.html`. Mentat python suites must be run from INSIDE `mentat/tests` (sibling-module imports), and a partial export cannot import `server` (needs `mentat/inputs`).
s10.why: "the previous commit as a negative control" is a commit, not text in the note
